title: Speed benchmark: 40-story RC frame
purpose: SP1 at 40 stories with 3 ft square columns: 4 x 3 bays of 25 ft, 8 in slabs as thin shells meshed at 5 ft (12,000 shell elements, 7,000 frame elements, beams split at every slab node, about 81,000 equations). Lateral load 1.5 kips x level number. Timed twice: linear (self-weight, superimposed load, lateral load and 12 modes) and nonlinear (P-Delta static under all three together). ETABS uses its advanced solver on all cores. The slab mesh is coarser than SP1's 2.5 ft (identical in both programs) so the model and its results stay a practical size.

settings.endOffsets: off (ETABS automatic end length offsets disabled, forces reported joint to joint)
settings.diaphragm: none: slabs in-plane stiff by their own shells
settings.solver: ETABS advanced solver, all cores; SkyFrame default (PARDISO when installed)
